title: Perlick — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Perlick.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Precision Cooling." Luxury tier. Perlick has been making commercial bar and beverage equipment since 1917 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Their residential line brings that commercial DNA to home bars and kitchens — undercounter refrigerators, freezers, wine reserves, and ice makers with full-extension stainless shelving and commercial compressors.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Home bar builds, wine enthusiasts, outdoor kitchens. Customers who want commercial-grade undercounter cooling.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Perlick:

• Milwaukee-made since 1917 — over 100 years of commercial cooling expertise

• Full-extension stainless steel shelving — no wire racks

• Commercial-grade compressors that outlast residential alternatives

• Indoor and outdoor-rated models available

• The brand bartenders and beverage professionals choose for home
